description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, step 4): appeal the return order with optional reasons (up to 1,000 characters). Atlas attaches its counterargument, and the live Magistrate decides one question: does the return order stand as written? Yes: it stands. No: it is vacated, stayed, or narrowed. Undecided: referred for deep review. The result is a live demonstration ruling on a synthetic practice matter; it is not certified and binds only this practice copy. The order stays in force during the appeal. One appeal per copy.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
